# Contributing to Azulejo

👋 Welcome to the team

There is not a lot of rules here for contributing, the main rule is that if you want to contribute the change to the repository, please create an issue first so we can discuss the change. Let's keep the PRs very contained to one feature/fix per PR. 

If you want to talk about something in more laid out manner, create a discussion thread on the **Discussions** page :)
